outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the closed drawer in frames 0–68 and closes its gripper around the handle in frames 69–75 (wrist_image). It pulls the drawer outward in frames 86–102, exposing the drawer sides and opening in image and left_ego_image. After the gripper releases and withdraws in frames 111–124, the drawer remains visibly open (image, left_ego_image). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
